summary.name: FunKey
summary.one_liner: FunKey is a paid iPhone keyboard extension that plays realistic mechanical keyboard sounds and haptic feedback as you type.
use_cases: Make typing on iPhone feel like a mechanical keyboard
Add satisfying key sounds to messaging and email
Practice writing or coding with keyboard audio feedback
summary.what_it_does: FunKey is a custom iOS keyboard extension that plays mechanical keyboard sounds whenever you type. It offers over 25 sound profiles, including MX Brown, Alpha Click, MX Oreo, Zen Rock, Smooth Line, Retro Punk, and Typewriter. It adds synchronized haptic feedback on each key press and has an adjustable volume setting. The page states that the app works entirely on-device and collects no keyboard data. The listing says it was updated to support iPhone Duo and adds new themes.
notable: Synchronized haptic feedback per key press
Works entirely on device; no keyboard data collected
Listed in awesome-mac under Menu Bar Tools
caveats: Requires iOS 17.0 or later on iPhone and macOS 13.0 or later on Mac
